_comment: Single source of truth for the spoken hit callouts. scripts/render-voice.sh reads this to produce hit-<n>.m4a, and voice.ts imports it for the subtitles, so the text and the audio cannot drift apart. Re-run the script after editing.
hit: Direct hit! Keep the pressure on.
Confirmed strike on the enemy vessel. Excellent marksmanship.
Solid hit. We've got their coordinates dialed in.
Target struck. Reload tubes and prepare for a follow-up.
That's a hit! Don't let up, pour it on them.
Bullseye. They're taking on water now.
